win.recordingEditor.mp4Unavailable: Saving video needs Windows Media Foundation, which this PC does not have (on Windows N editions, install the Media Feature Pack). You can still save a GIF.
win.recordingEditor.openFailed: This recording can't be played on this PC. Save keeps the original video file so you can open it elsewhere.
win.recordingEditor.openSample: Open a sample recording in the editor
recorderExport.previewNote: Applies to the saved and copied video and GIF. The editing preview stays at 1×; the original recording is unchanged.
